The Henley Philosophy

Handpicked, small batch, organically extracted.

We believe tea should be approached the way a master perfumer approaches scent. We partner exclusively with high-altitude growers who reject industrial homogenization. Every leaf is plucked at dawn before mountain dew evaporates, preserving delicate volatile aromatic compounds that mass-market processing burns away.

Dr. Alistair Henley Master Botanical Curator
